diagnosis.finding: On this macOS environment, npm's node_modules/.bin PATH introduces the geckodriver JavaScript shim. Its CLI calls download() before forwarding --version. Selenium Manager driver discovery stalled with that PATH, including offline and skip-driver-in-path probes; ordinary PATH immediately found the existing browser and cached driver. Removing only npm geckodriver-shim directories for the MCP process restored actual calls.
diagnosis.limits: No packet capture: do not claim a specific blocked download host as independently established. Skip-driver-in-path was experimentally insufficient in the pinned Manager version. No upstream package files or global PATH were changed.

fix.ownership: First-party Registry compatibility bootstrap; not Mozilla-authored code
fix.notes: npx runs Node with a generated inline JavaScript bootstrap. Source is reviewable and descriptor/source equality is tested. Resolves the pinned package inside npm PATH, rejects version mismatch and an escaping entry symlink, removes npm shim directories only in this process, then imports the unchanged official entry. This is compatibility handling, not a sandbox or supply-chain integrity substitute.
